song.title: Infinite Stroll
song.style: English, cheerful folk march, accordion, snare drum, tuba, whistling, warm friendly male lead vocal, slightly raspy, rousing group backing vocals, 112 BPM
song.lyrics:
[Verse]
Thumb was tired from the scroll
Couch was swallowing me whole
Grabbed my boots and grabbed my hat
Walked right out and that was that

[Chorus]
Infinite stroll, on and on
Over the hill and past the pond
Never ends and that's the deal
Infinite stroll, the feed is real

shots.prompt: {moss} slumps deeper and deeper into a saggy brown couch until the cushions nearly swallow him, only his beanie and glasses poking out. Static medium shot. Dim grey indoor light.
{moss} springs up from the couch and hurriedly tugs his beanie down over his ears, determined. Static medium shot. Light brightening.
{moss} flings open a round wooden front door and steps out into bright sunshine, squinting and then grinning wide. The camera pushes in. Warm morning light.
{moss} strolls over the top of a grassy green hill, arms swinging high, a big round sun behind him. The camera tracks alongside. Bright morning light, grass green and sky blue.

A cream t-shirt with a simple illustration of rolling green hills and a winding path shaped like an infinity loop hangs on a wooden hanger against a sunny cream wall, gently swaying in a breeze from an open window. Soft daylight, warm shadows. Static close-up.
{moss} walks past a little pond and waves at a duck, which quacks back at him. Static wide shot. Dappled light, soft blues and greens.
{moss} walks along an endless winding path through rolling hills as a small bird lands on his yellow pom-pom. The camera follows from behind. Golden light.
{moss} walks arm in arm with two new friends who have joined him on the path, all three laughing. The camera tracks backward in front of them. Warm afternoon light.
{moss} sits at the top of a hill at sunset, takes a deep breath and smiles as the path winds away below him. The camera slowly pulls back. Peach and gold, calm.

caption: Moss traded the infinite scroll for the Infinite Stroll tee. Day 1. The feed is trees now.
